'''Blast shields''' were a type of shielding technology employed on [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, rather then an energy shield, they were made out of a type of alloy and were closed using motors
